topFixes.title: Headline copy is free of AI buzzwords
topFixes.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
topFixes.evidence: Buzzwords in headings: unlock, elevate, seamless, supercharge, effortless, effortlessly
topFixes.fix: Rewrite the headline as a concrete outcome for a named customer ("Plumber at your door in 60 minutes"), not "Unlock seamless..."

topFixes.title: No template placeholder copy left in
topFixes.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
topFixes.fix: Replace every placeholder (lorem ipsum, "Your Company", sample names) with real copy.

topFixes.title: Meta description present
topFixes.fix: Add <meta name="description"> with a one-sentence promise and a reason to click.

topFixes.title: Typeface is not the default AI pick
topFixes.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
topFixes.fix: Pick a typeface with a point of view (a characterful serif or grotesk) and keep Inter/Roboto for UI text only, if at all.

topFixes.title: Lists do not lead with emoji
topFixes.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
topFixes.evidence: 4 items start with emoji, e.g. "🚀 Blazing fast — out of the box"
topFixes.fix: Replace emoji bullets with plain bullets, numbers or a real icon set used sparingly.

findings.title: Typeface is not the default AI pick
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.fix: Pick a typeface with a point of view (a characterful serif or grotesk) and keep Inter/Roboto for UI text only, if at all.

findings.title: No purple/violet "AI gradient"
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.fix: Replace the purple-to-blue gradient with a flat brand colour or a palette pulled from your product or photography.

findings.title: Headlines are not gradient-filled text
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.fix: Set headline text in one solid colour; let weight, size and spacing carry emphasis.

findings.title: No tracked all-caps "eyebrow" labels
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.fix: Drop the small uppercase eyebrow above each heading, or keep one, at most, with normal letter spacing.

findings.title: Lists do not lead with emoji
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.evidence: 4 items start with emoji, e.g. "🚀 Blazing fast — out of the box"
findings.fix: Replace emoji bullets with plain bullets, numbers or a real icon set used sparingly.

findings.title: Headline copy is free of AI buzzwords
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.evidence: Buzzwords in headings: unlock, elevate, seamless, supercharge, effortless, effortlessly
findings.fix: Rewrite the headline as a concrete outcome for a named customer ("Plumber at your door in 60 minutes"), not "Unlock seamless..."

findings.title: No default glassmorphism blur panels
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.fix: Use solid surfaces with a clear border instead of frosted blur cards.

findings.title: No template placeholder copy left in
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.fix: Replace every placeholder (lorem ipsum, "Your Company", sample names) with real copy.

findings.title: Em dashes are not overused in copy
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.fix: Rewrite most em dashes as full stops or commas; heavy em-dash use reads as machine-written.

findings.title: Body copy avoids stock AI phrases
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.evidence: Stock phrases: in today's fast-paced, delve, tapestry, look no further
findings.fix: Cut stock phrases ("in today's fast-paced world", "delve", "look no further") and say the specific thing.

findings.title: Accent colour is not the framework default indigo/violet
findings.source: site-slopcard heuristic (tell list informed by Nutlope/hallmark + Leonxlnx/taste-skill, MIT)
findings.fix: Swap the stock indigo/violet accent for your own brand colour.

findings.title: Title is 30-65 characters
findings.fix: Rewrite the title to 30-65 characters so it is not truncated in results.

findings.title: Meta description present
findings.fix: Add <meta name="description"> with a one-sentence promise and a reason to click.

findings.title: Meta description is 70-160 characters
findings.fix: Keep the description between 70 and 160 characters.

findings.title: Canonical URL declared
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://your-domain/page"> to stop duplicate-URL dilution.

findings.title: Open Graph title, description and image
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description and og:image so shared links render a proper card.

findings.title: Twitter/X card meta
findings.fix: Add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">.

findings.title: Valid JSON-LD structured data
findings.fix: Add a JSON-LD block (Organization or LocalBusiness at minimum) and make sure it parses.

findings.title: Images have alt text (90%+)
findings.fix: Give every meaningful image a descriptive alt; use alt="" for pure decoration.

findings.title: <html lang> set
findings.fix: Add lang="en" (or your language) to the <html> tag.

findings.title: Mobile viewport meta
findings.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.

findings.title: sitemap.xml reachable
findings.fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.title: /llms.txt published
findings.fix: Publish /llms.txt: a short markdown map of who you are, what you offer and your key pages.

findings.title: robots.txt present
findings.fix: Publish /robots.txt with your sitemap line and explicit rules for AI crawlers.

findings.title: Answer-ready schema (FAQPage / HowTo / QAPage)
findings.fix: Mark up your real customer questions with FAQPage JSON-LD (only questions shown on the page).

findings.title: Entity schema (Organization / LocalBusiness / Person)
findings.fix: Add Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD with name, url, logo and sameAs profiles.

findings.title: At least one question-style heading
findings.evidence: No H2/H3 phrased as a question
findings.fix: Phrase one or two H2/H3s as the questions buyers actually ask ("How much does X cost?").

findings.title: Freshness signal (dateModified or <time>)
findings.fix: Expose a last-updated date: dateModified in JSON-LD or a visible <time datetime>.

findings.title: No mixed (http://) content
findings.fix: Load every script, stylesheet, image and iframe over https://.

findings.title: No secret-shaped keys in page source
findings.evidence: OpenAI-style secret key: sk-F…(38 chars); Google API key: AIza…(36 chars); Slack token: xoxb…(36 chars)
findings.fix: Move secrets server-side, rotate any exposed key now, and restrict public browser keys by referrer.

findings.title: Public CDN scripts use Subresource Integrity
findings.evidence: 1 CDN script(s) without integrity, e.g. cdn.jsdelivr.net
findings.fix: Add integrity="sha384-..." crossorigin="anonymous" to scripts loaded from public CDNs.

findings.title: Forms point somewhere real
findings.fix: Give every form a real action (your handler or form service), not "#" or javascript:.

findings.title: Form fields are labelled
findings.fix: Give every field a <label for>, aria-label or wrapping <label> so screen readers and autofill work.

findings.title: Email fields use type="email"
findings.fix: Set type="email" on email fields for validation and the right mobile keyboard.

findings.title: A clear call-to-action exists
findings.evidence: No button or link with an action verb
findings.fix: Add one primary button with a verb and an outcome ("Get my free quote").

findings.title: Instant channel (phone or WhatsApp)
findings.fix: Add a tap-to-call (tel:) or WhatsApp (wa.me) link for visitors ready to talk now.
